determinism.notes: The real browser shot/flight/impact path produced the release-profile incident without forced outcome rolls. Public/UI reads do not consume incident RNG; an existing ammunition task and aim progress freeze/continue according to the safety contract.

performance.notes: State-only, effect-ingest and actual Chromium frame-callback measurements are separate. The browser measurement includes simulation, Canvas and scheduled DOM work and is not a physical-mobile FPS guarantee.
